service_boundary: Represents routed Inference Providers requests, not dedicated Hugging Face Inference Endpoints, the Hub model repository, local inference, or the upstream providers themselves.
regional_controls: Processing location depends on the selected upstream provider and model; the proxy does not establish one universal Hugging Face inference region.
retention_controls: Requests traverse Hugging Face proxy infrastructure and the selected provider unless a custom provider key path states otherwise; both layers' data policies apply.
routing: Automatic selection can prefer fastest, cheapest, or user-preferred providers and can fail over when a provider is unavailable; callers can also name a provider explicitly.
customization: The service routes existing provider-model combinations and is not a customer-weight deployment product.
strengths: One token and client can access many integrated providers and models.
Explicit fastest, cheapest, preferred, and provider-specific selection policies are documented.
tradeoffs: Requests add a proxy boundary and may reach different upstream operators.
Residency, retention, capabilities, and availability remain provider-specific.
